fields.statement: At ee31e06b, QA built rhiza from the branch head and ran it by hand. On this repo, rhiza health printed all eight parts and exited 0 (inbox warn for a blocker). health --json and api call health gave the same bytes. In a fresh scratch repo with a bare origin: with no daemon, daemon was warn with 'start it with rhiza daemon', next rhiza daemon --autonomous. A missing rendered folder made check bad with fail render, and health exited 1. With RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES=100 (and RHIZA_TEST_NOW), disk was bad '100 B free, under the minimum of 10.0 GiB', exit 1. A dirty README made main warn 'uncommitted changes', and a push from another clone made main warn '1 behind origin/main'. The inbox-failed case was covered only by health.txtar (passes), not by hand.

At ee31e06b, QA ran the real rhiza ship close-out by hand in a scratch repo with a bare origin, a change set and a ship state recording a merge commit. With README dirty, close-out exited 1 with 'main was not updated: ... has uncommitted changes' and wrote .git/rhiza/main-stale.json. rhiza health showed main warn '...; the last close-out could not pull' with a detail naming the change set, the time and the failure. rhiza inbox listed one main-stale item, and inbox open on it said there is no tab to open, next rhiza health. A second failing close-out kept the same since. After cleaning README and pushing a new commit to origin, close-out printed 'Updated main', pulled the commit and removed main-stale.json. Health main was back to ok and the inbox said 'Nothing waits on you'.

At ee31e06b, QA ran the real app. In a scratch repo, rhiza tui app health --once printed the same bytes as rhiza health --json. With free disk under the minimum it printed state bad and exited 0. rhiza rex install into a temp REX_CONFIG wrote rhiza_app_health running tui app health with ["health"] = "t", and no key letter is used twice. QA launched rhiza tui app health in a real Rex block with a dirty checkout. It showed 'Health: warn' with each part marked [ok]/[warn], the cursor on daemon and the footer 'j/k move · enter open app · r reload · q quit'. After cleaning the checkout, r reloaded it and main became [ok]. j moved the cursor to inbox, and enter opened the inbox app ('Nothing waits on you', inbox footer). The healthapp unit tests and tui-health-app/rex-install scripts pass.
